limitations: No original frozen artifact or published/root file was modified. No full-bundle AST, target/UI/model/network request execution or account/history/credential access.
Direct input pins and original reused journal bytes are checked; historical indirect input-pin mismatches in prior work are not resolved here.

Saved scopes establish the recorded import/export and AW receiver assignment chain, not a complete formal whole-program proof. Selected newly parsed factories/classes/functions are original complete ranges.
Concrete e6.httpFetch and Vf host implementations, computed headers/helper values, initialization execution, final endpoint/base URL and actual request completion remain unknown.
Source response/logging/identity-marker branches do not establish authenticated service access or current account values.
Headers and frontend/window labels are request metadata; they do not by themselves prove Codex/ChatGPT-only mode or safe module removal.
Same-named BY export in app-initial is a separate vko initializer; same symbol spelling across bundles is not module/service identity.
Existing 18 consumer calls are source candidates in three of nine saved candidate files; no full request/feature denominator or complete mode classification inferred.
parserPolicy: Only bounded original functions plus complete saved class/export spans are parsed. Isolated export parsing allows undeclared locals; export/local identity is supplied by prior full-module AST binding index and exact hashes, not inferred from isolated parser scope.

validation.scope: Static artifact/source/index/reference consistency only; not runtime/mode/HTTP completion verification.
